# Moil

> Moil is the AI co-founder for local shops. It learns the business once, then writes the plan and a 30-day Moil360 calendar in English and Spanish. Moil Enterprise Inc., Buda, Texas. Not a hiring platform. Not affiliated with MOIL Limited (India).

Professional is $25 a month (research, plan, coaching, documents). The full Moil360 calendar is Market Pro, $75. Start free, no card.

## Core pages
- [For Business](https://www.moilapp.com/business): AI co-founder for local shops — research, plan, and coaching.
- [Pricing](https://www.moilapp.com/business/pricing): Professional ($25/mo) and Market Pro ($75/mo, full Moil360 calendar).
- [Para Empresas (Español)](https://www.moilapp.com/es/business): Spanish-language version of the business product.
- [Moil360](https://www.moilapp.com/marketing): 30-day calendar — Market Pro, $75.
- [Moil vs ChatGPT](https://www.moilapp.com/compare/moil-vs-chatgpt): How the AI co-founder differs from a blank chat.
- [Moil vs Claude](https://www.moilapp.com/compare/moil-vs-claude): How the AI co-founder differs from a blank chat.
- [Contact](https://www.moilapp.com/contact): Reach Moil Enterprise Inc.

## What Moil replaces
- A business consultant ($5,000–$15,000 per engagement) — Moil writes the plan and coaches at $25 a month.
- A marketing agency retainer ($3,000–$8,000/month) — Moil360 (Market Pro, $75) writes the 30-day calendar.

## Key facts
- Pricing: Professional $25/month (co-founder: research, plan, coaching, documents). Market Pro $75/month (full Moil360 calendar). First conversation free, no card.
- Languages: English and Spanish (fully bilingual end to end).
- Audience: local shops and small-business owners.
- Company: Moil Enterprise Inc., founded 2023, Buda, Texas, USA.
- Disambiguation: Not affiliated with MOIL Limited (India). Not a hiring platform.
